triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in area:ux · domain:ui · Feature · p2 · pm:queue · size M; rationale: maintainer-directed (filed on the HotCRM project thread's decision card). An object should be able to say which fields fill a related-list phone card's subtitle, with labels or a format, and add an optional title prefix. Today the card takes the first two cells. Companion of #37890. p2 stands. Recorded 2026-11-27T09:13Z.

repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Decision anchor · 2026-11-28T06:13Z · drafted by the #37891 card thread from its pre-claim report (`/mnt/project-files/card-37891/pre-claim-report-7605e0c9.md`), posted by the seat. The card moves to `needs-user-decision`; no claim until it is ruled.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：手机上看订单明细，每张卡片的副标题只写「1 · 2」这样两个没有名称的数字（行号和数量），右下角显示的是单价而不是这一行的合计；要改只能改电脑上宽表格的列顺序，而宽表格要求不动。
- 选项：A 不加新配置，手机卡片改为按对象已有的「最重要字段」排序取字段，数字带上名称（例如「数量 2 · 单价 ¥6,000.00 · 折扣 10%」），合计放右下角，约一个改动；但 HotCRM 现有的手机列表卡片几乎全部会跟着变（138 处里 134 处），要它顺手把每个对象的「最重要字段」重排一遍。B 给相关列表单独加一项「卡片显示哪些字段、哪个是金额、标题前加什么」的配置，只有写了的地方才变，能做行号小前缀，约两个较大的改动，要你审批。
- 推荐 A：平台已经定过「哪些字段最重要由对象声明，所有界面共用」，卡片照这条走，不再为一个界面另开一套规则。行号前缀在 A 下不做，除非你另说要做。
- 不定会怎样：订单明细在手机上继续显示看不懂的「1 · 2」，右下角继续把单价当成金额，相关的 HotCRM 订单明细卡片一直挂着等。

---

os-decision-facets
- ① Long-term soundness: A shrinks special cases (the phone card joins the one cross-surface importance role ADR-0085 already rules on); B grows them (a fourth ruled exception to ADR-0085 §2, a card-only key on relatedLists entries, and two card rules from then on: related-list cards vs every other phone list).
- ② Real business pull: today HotCRM order lines (crm_sales_order_line, hotcrm#2828, mock-up approved by the maintainer on the HotCRM thread 2026-11-27) and, by its own card, quote line items; every app with line items on phones reads the same unlabelled pair.
- ③ AI-error resistance: A adds no key, so there is nothing new to misspell; a wrong highlightFields order shows the wrong fields loudly on the card, never a silent no-op. B is a strict object (unknown keys refused) with field-name refs checked at validate, also loud, but it is one more place an AI author must remember to write.
- ④ Startup no-sprawl: A declares nothing new. B is a permanent authorable key (spec, Studio form, 11 locale packs, lint ref check, liveness row, ADR note) that every later card change must keep.
Prior rulings read: highlightfields,card subtitle,phone card,relatedlistcolumns,surface hint → 1 hits; ADR-0085 §1/§2 (+ notes 2026-10-28, 2026-11-20, 2026-11-23, 2026-11-27); thread: #37891 1 comment (triage, no ruling); repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## Background

On a phone (below 768 px) a list or related list draws each record as a card: a title (the object's nameField), one subtitle line, and an amount line with the status chip. Since #28484 the subtitle is the first two shown columns that are not the title, the status or the amount, joined with " · ", unlabelled. Since #37890 (PR #38100, merged) the amount is the first shown column that draws as money, a formula returning currency included. Both are read off the table's column order. A related list's columns are the child FK's `relatedListColumns` or the parent's `relatedLists[].columns`, and the same set draws the wide table, so the card cannot change without changing the table.

HotCRM order lines (hotcrm main 9b3a9ba) declare `relatedListColumns: ['line_number','product_title','quantity','unit_price','discount','total_price']` and `highlightFields: ['crm_product','quantity','unit_price','total_price']`. The maintainer-approved mock-up (hotcrm#2828) wants a small line-number prefix on the title, a labelled subtitle "Qty 1 × Unit Price ¥2,000.00 · Discount 10%" (discount only when there is one) and the line total bottom right, with the wide table unchanged.

## Governing text

- ADR-0085 §1 (Accepted 2026-07-16): an object declares presentation intent only as object-level semantic roles consumed by every surface. `highlightFields` answers "which fields matter most, in priority order ([0] wins where only one fits)", with consumers listed as default list/grid columns, previews, the detail strip and "future: kanban card fields — Salesforce compact-layout semantics". The spec describe (packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:4824) already says it "drives … cards".
- ADR-0085 §2 admission test: a new presentation key must (1) carry business intent a machine cannot infer and (2) bind across surfaces; "if the honest name for the key contains a page name, it fails". A related-list card layout key names a surface and fails (2).
- Three ruled exceptions stand, each from the maintainer's own words: `relatedLists` as the tab list (2026-11-20), `actionLayout` (2026-11-23, ruling 7101013317), `pinOverview` + `fieldTabs` (2026-11-27, records 7209632085 / 7209608089). A card key would be the fourth.

## Protocol declaration

- A: no spec change. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. It changes what an existing role drives on one renderer (a behaviour change the seat should judge as such); the spec describe line of `highlightFields` may gain the word "phone card" (prose only).
- B: `Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: added` (a new optional key on `RelatedListEntryObjectSchema`, or beside the FK's `relatedListColumns`), plus an ADR-0085 dated note. Tier H (ADR path: mandated claude-fable-5-2 / xhigh, `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` measured on 7605e0c9).

## Premise (re-check on main)

Measured on objectstack origin/main 7605e0c9, vitest at 390 px, HotCRM order-line fields verbatim, CNY (probe: /mnt/project-files/card-37891/probe-37891.test.tsx, readings beside it):

| Columns | highlightFields | Subtitle | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| HotCRM relatedListColumns | as shipped | `1 · 2` | CN¥6,000.00 (unit price; total is 10,800.00) |
| total_price moved before quantity | none | `1 · 2` | CN¥10,800.00 |
| HotCRM relatedListColumns | total_price, quantity, unit_price, discount | `1 · 2` | CN¥6,000.00 |

Re-check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/probe-37891.test.tsx` after copying the probe in and building `@object-ui/plugin-grid^...`. So #37890 alone does not fix the HotCRM amount (the unit price is the first money column), the card ignores `highlightFields` today, and only a table reorder moves anything.

## Concrete question

Where does a phone card get its subtitle fields and its amount from, so an object can make its card readable without reordering its wide table: from the object's existing importance role (A), or from a new card-only declaration on the related list (B)? And is the line-number title prefix part of this card?

## Options

| Option | What is built | What the customer sees | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| A — cards follow `highlightFields` | When the object declares `highlightFields`, the phone card takes its amount = the first money field in that list, and its subtitle = the next fields in that order (skipping title, status, the title formula's reads), at most 3 parts, empty values dropped; number, currency and percent parts carry their localized field label; the grid fetch asks for those fields as it already asks for the name field. No declaration: today's column-order rule. Title prefix: not built. | HotCRM changes one line (`highlightFields: ['total_price','quantity','unit_price','discount']`); the order-line card reads "Quantity 2 · Sales Price ¥6,000.00 · Discount % 10.00%" with ¥10,800.00 bottom right; the table is unchanged. Every other phone list of an object that declares `highlightFields` also changes (counts below). No "×" joiner; a 0% discount still shows (0 is a value, not empty). | ui lane · 1 PR (plugin-grid card renderer + tests + patch changeset), est. 150–300 lines · precedent #38100 (#37890) +130/−5 · default tier · plus one HotCRM PR re-ordering `highlightFields` on its objects after the release |
| B — card key on the related list (fourth ADR-0085 exception) | A strict optional `card` on a `relatedLists` entry (or a FK sibling of `relatedListColumns`): subtitle fields, amount field, title-prefix field, refs checked at validate; renderer reads it on related lists only; ADR-0085 note; Studio form row, 11 locale packs, liveness row. | Only lists that declare it change. HotCRM gets the line-number prefix and exact fields; other phone lists stay as they are; the order-line card still cannot use "×" unless a format is added too. | ui + spec · 2 PRs (spec/form/lint/ADR, then renderer), size L · no landed precedent; nearest are `fieldTabs` #37802 and `pinOverview` #37792, both in flight · Tier H, fable/xhigh on the ADR PR |
| C — format template string (the card's "small format template") | A per-list template such as "{quantity} × {unit_price}". | Exactly the mock-up text, per locale. | Not costed: free text the author must write per locale pack, wrong placeholders fail at runtime; not recommended. |

Measured blast radius of A (rough, static: objects and grid views loaded with tsx, card simulated for each shown list surface; script and log in /mnt/project-files/card-37891/measure/, objectstack 7605e0c9, hotcrm 9b3a9ba). A "surface" is one list view with columns, one related list with columns, or the derived default list of an object with no grid view.

| Corpus | Objects with highlightFields | Card surfaces | Change under A (3 parts) | Change if capped at 2 parts | Amount changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| platform-objects | 62 of 65 | 64 | 28 (all only gain a third part on the derived default list) | 0 | 0 |
| examples | 11 of 33 | 20 | 15 | 6 | 0 |
| HotCRM | 38 of 38 | 138 (77 list views, 55 related lists, 6 default) | 134 | 96 | 22 |
| Total | | 222 | 177 | 102 | 22 |

So almost all of A's visible change lands on HotCRM, whose `highlightFields` order differs from its list views' column order on nearly every object; platform objects only gain a third subtitle part. Under A, 63 surfaces carry at least one labelled part (10 platform, 6 examples, 47 HotCRM); 3 of those (1 platform, 2 examples) change only by gaining labels, which brings A's visible change to 180 of 222. A variant that keeps the list's own columns and only ranks them by `highlightFields` was measured too: HotCRM 121 of 138 still change, so it buys little and is not offered.

## Business meaning

- A: the object says once which of its fields matter most, and every screen, the phone card included, shows those first, the way a CRM's compact layout drives its mobile cards. Like rewriting a product's spec sheet once rather than per catalogue page.
- B: each related list gets its own little phone layout, set separately from the rest of the app. Like a printed insert that only one catalogue page carries.
- C: a sentence with blanks to fill in, written once per language.

## Four axes (business stance)

- ① Long-term: in two years the platform should draw a record's compact face (phone card, kanban card, hover card, picker) from a few object roles: what it is called, which fields matter most, what its money figure is. That is ADR-0085's own end state and its named reference, the CRM compact layout. A walks toward it; B adds a surface-only layer that later has to be reconciled with the kanban and hover cards.
- ② Pull: one approved HotCRM mock-up today (order lines; quote lines for consistency). The pull is real but narrow, and A satisfies it apart from the "×" joiner and the line-number prefix.
- ③ AI-error: with A, an AI author who orders `highlightFields` badly sees the wrong fields on the card, loudly; there is no key to get silently wrong. With B the key is strict and checked, also loud, but an AI must learn a second place where card fields live, and the two can disagree.
- ④ No sprawl: A adds no key; B adds a permanent one with its form, locale and liveness obligations.

## Recommendation

A. Reason, from ① alone: the platform has already ruled that "which fields matter most" is declared once on the object and drives every surface, and the phone card is exactly such a surface; B would be a fourth exception for a need the existing role covers.

Not chosen: B, because it adds a per-surface layout layer ADR-0085 rejects, for a need A covers apart from the prefix and the joiner. C, because free-text templates per locale are the shape AI authors break silently.

Line-number prefix: under A it is not built unless the maintainer asks. If wanted, HotCRM can make the order line's nameField a formula ("1. Implementation Services"), which the card already draws as a title and whose parts the subtitle already skips, but the record page heading changes the same way. Under B it is part of the key.

Self-check: only ① chooses A; do ②③④ flip it: no. ② (HotCRM's 134 changed surfaces) only orders the rollout: the HotCRM re-order lands with the release that ships A.

Confidence gaps: the blast-radius count is a static simulation (views read from exported objects, status by name, masking and per-view type overrides ignored), so treat it as ±10%; whether each changed HotCRM card is better or worse was not judged one by one; the CRM compact-layout reference is ADR-0085's, not re-verified for mobile related lists. Effort ratio B:A is about 3× or more (2 L PRs at Tier H vs 1 ~150–300-line PR).

## After the ruling

- If A: the seat claims #37891 as a ui card (`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, default tier, effort high, `mode:thread` in this card thread). One PR: plugin-grid card renderer reads `highlightFields` for the amount and subtitle (at most 3 parts, labels on number/currency/percent parts, empty dropped), the grid fetch adds those fields, tests at 390 px (HotCRM order-line fixture + a no-highlightFields control + a masked-field control), patch changeset whose note says phone cards of objects with `highlightFields` change. Then a HotCRM card (Blocked-by #37891, restart at the release pin) re-orders `highlightFields` on the order line and quote line, and reviews the other 36 objects' order so their phone cards stay sensible. hotcrm#2828's restart line is updated by its seat: the order line needs only the `highlightFields` change.
- If B: the seat files the ADR-0085 dated note + spec/form/lint PR as Tier H (fable/xhigh), then the renderer PR; HotCRM declares the card on the order line and quote line after the release pin.
- Either way: the line-number prefix follows the maintainer's word on it; nothing changes on desktop tables.

## Related

- #37890 / PR #38100 (merged): amount slot counts currency formulas, still picks by column order.
- #28484 (closed): one-line unlabelled subtitle. #37008 (closed): labels in the gallery path. #37010: formula name field titles the card.
- #38084: parent topic (record layout and phone cards). hotcrm#2828: the HotCRM ask, blocked on #37890 and this card.
- ADR-0085 exceptions in flight: #37802 (`fieldTabs`), #37792 (`pinOverview`).

Claim amendment (file surface), for claim 7235321485. The card's rows reach the phone card through three fetches, each of which already collects the name field on its own line, so "the grid fetch asks for those fields" covers all three:
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRowLoad.ts` (`getSelectFields`): the grid's own fetch.
- Added: `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, the harvest beside objectui#13116's `addSpeculative(declaredNameField)`: list-page rows.
- Added: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, the `$select` name-field arm (~2002): related-list tab rows, handed to the grid as `data: { provider: 'value' }`.
Each adds one line collecting `highlightFields` through its existing FLS / declared-field gate, with one top-level describe in its existing fetch test file. Changesets add `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch. Without the two, `highlightFields` not shown as a column read empty on list pages and related lists and drop off the card, so the ruled card would apply on one path of three. Clause-② no and Metadata-protocol none are unchanged.
